_meta.description: Observation snapshot of canonical BeTiSe compositions and categorical variants. Runtime generation policies are defined in scenario_builder.py.
notes: This file is an observation snapshot.
Continuous numeric ranges come from params.json.
Contextual anomaly requires deterministic Fourier seasonality.
A dense feature alone supports up to 3 events; two or more dense features support at most 2 events each.
Counts cover combination sizes 1-5 without the short-length filter.
